current_localization_type.description: Type of localization filter to apply. Values: 'country', 'state', 'division'

current_localization_id.description: List of locations {Matching 'current_localization_type' criteria.} In case of current_localization_type == 'country', this value must be only the id of the country and not a list.

operation_types.description: List of operations types to filter. Values 1: Sale, 2: Rent, 3: Temporary_rent

property_types.description: List of property types to filter. Values 1: Land, 2: Appartment, 3: House, 4: Weekend house, 5: Office, 6: Mooring, 7: Bussiness premises, 8:Commercial Building

currency.description: Currency filter, Values: USD or ARS

with_tags.description: List of tags that the property must contain. Check the Tags Api to check available tags.

without_tags.description: List of tags that the property must not contain. Check the Tags Api to check available tags.

with_custom_tags.description: List of custom tags that the property must contain. Check the Tags Api to check available custom tags.

without_custom_tags.description: List of custom tags that the property must not contain. Check the Tags Api to check available custom tags.

filters.description: List of advanced filters. Filter definition: ['<field_name>', '<operator>', '<value>'] for numeric fields, using '>', '<', '=' operators or ['<field_name>', '<value>', ''] for booleans.

operations.notes:
Return all of the available properties.
This properties must've been marked as "show on web" on their details.
Requires Api Key.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the results, defaults to 'en'

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the results, defaults to 'json'

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to show. Default: 20

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of result item to start showing. Useful for pagination purposes {Combined with 'limit' parameter}. Default: 0

parameters.name: filtered_attributes
parameters.description: If true, the response will retrieve only the attributes that are configured and are not empty. Default: False

operations.notes:
Return all of the available properties that fit the search parameters.
This properties must've been marked as "show on web" on their details.
Requires Api Key.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the results, defaults to 'en'

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the results, defaults to 'json'

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to show. Default: 20

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of result item to start showing. Useful for pagination purposes {Combined with 'limit' parameter}. Default: 0

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Name of the field to order the results by. Notes: it can also be used the option 'random' which will shuffle the results within the limit+offset combination {Useful for starred items}. Default: price

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sets the way the order_by option is used. Default: ASC

Searching for all properties in Argentina (Country=1), which are available for all operations, and the prices are between USD 0 and USD 4.500.000. Also it must have more than 2 bathrooms, Expenses be lower than 400, must have Jacuzzi (34), Solarium (40) and must not be work able (47).
